name: How it works, zigzag timeline
description: Numbered steps on a center line, alternating sides from one step to the next.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: From a sketch on paper to a table in your kitchen

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Every piece is built by one maker in our Sheffield workshop. Here is how it comes together.

default.label: Week 1
default.title: We visit your space
default.text: A maker measures the room, talks through how you live in it and brings timber samples to hold in the light.

default.label: Week 2
default.title: You approve the drawings
default.text: Scaled drawings and a fixed quote arrive by email. Change anything you like before a single board is cut.

default.label: Weeks 3 to 8
default.title: Built by hand in Sheffield
default.text: Your maker sends photos at each stage, from the rough-sawn boards to the final coat of oil.

default.label: Week 9
default.title: Delivered and fitted
default.text: Two of the team carry it in, level it and take every scrap of packaging away with them.

default.label: For life
default.title: Cared for after
default.text: Bring it back for a free refinish whenever it needs one. Scratches are part of the story, not the end of it.
